title: Interference and coherence
design_rationale: Build interference from coherence, phase and path difference, then connect the conditions to the required experimental contexts.
concepts_taught: understand the terms interference and coherence
show an understanding of experiments that demonstrate two-source interference using water waves in a ripple tank, sound, light and microwaves
understand the conditions required if two-source interference fringes are to be observed

next_module_can_assume: understand the terms interference and coherence
